svg.title: Relief with Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Neutral contour guides distinguish all-white relief edges; depth omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.moma.org/collection/works/82211; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
